mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% for two consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% and remains above for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such regimes are not statistically lower than in pre-rate hike periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment costs from increasing monthly PAYEMS relative to GDP growth (INDPRO) reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > INDPRO growth rate
failure_condition: IC > 0.05 over 5-year windows when the trigger is active.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in consumer demand measured by HOUST coinciding with a sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as market anticipates economic contraction.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 10% while INDPRO falls > 15% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not turn negative when both indicators fall as specified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) beyond 2% monthly growth signals supply expansion that outpaces demand, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods with strong INDPRO acceleration (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months during a recession, the expectation of lower labor costs supports equity valuation expansion, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not higher than average in such UNRATE regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in job openings (PAYEMS) without a corresponding rise in hiring (PAYEMS lagged) suggests labor market imbalances that weigh on equity valuations, yielding negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS current month > 2x PAYEMS previous month
failure_condition: IC < 0.1 over 6 months when the trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of falling consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% suggest central bank patience, reducing the probability of a near-term rate hike and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not statistically positive when CPIAUCSL remains < 2% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction (not available in the provided catalog) cannot be used; instead, a strong acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with rising consumer confidence proxies (not available) is not possible. Instead, a two-proxy interaction using INDPRO and HOUST: when industrial production accelerates while consumer demand (HOUST) remains flat, it signals supply-led growth that boosts equity valuations, producing positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO acceleration > 2% monthly while HOUST growth <= 1% monthly
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when the interaction trigger is active (p > 0.05).
